descriptions.apiKeysEnabled: Let users create personal API keys for programmatic backend access. Affects the API keys section in user settings.
descriptions.apiKeysMaxPerUser: Maximum number of active API keys a single user may hold at once.
descriptions.askForRealName: Ask new users for their real (given and family) name during registration instead of a single display name.
descriptions.badgesEnabled: Enable the badges feature: badges are shown on profiles and teasers and can be managed in the admin area.
descriptions.categoriesActive: Enable topic categories for posts and groups so content can be classified and filtered. Requires at least one category to exist.
descriptions.groupsEnabled: Enable the groups feature: users can create and browse groups (and start group video calls). Also gates the groups button in the header.
descriptions.inviteCodesGroupPerUser: Maximum number of group invite codes a single user may generate per group.
descriptions.inviteCodesPersonalPerUser: Maximum number of personal invite codes a single user may generate.
descriptions.inviteLinkLimit: Maximum number of personal invite links a single user may have.
descriptions.inviteRegistration: Let existing members invite new users via invite codes. When off, invite codes cannot be redeemed to sign up.
descriptions.maxGroupPinnedPosts: Maximum number of posts that can be pinned within a group. Set to 0 to disable pinning in groups.
descriptions.maxPinnedPosts: Maximum number of posts that can be pinned network-wide (admins). Set to 0 to disable pinning.
descriptions.publicRegistration: Allow anyone to create an account directly, without an invite code. When off, new users can only join via an invitation.
descriptions.requireLocation: Make a location mandatory during registration and in profile settings.
descriptions.showContentFilterHeaderMenu: Show the content filter in the header menu.
descriptions.showContentFilterMasonryGrid: Show the content filter in the masonry grid (newsfeed).
descriptions.showGroupButtonInHeader: Show the groups button in the header.
descriptions.socialMediaEnabled: Enable the social-media links feature: links are shown on profiles and managed in user settings.
descriptions.videoConference: Enable video conferencing (LiveKit). The runtime switch for the video-call permissions. Requires the LiveKit environment variables; without them it stays off and greyed out.
